descriptionChirho: The Aramaic masculine noun שֻׁם meaning 'name,' cognate with Hebrew שֵׁם, appearing exclusively in the Aramaic portions of Daniel and Ezra. All three clusters represent the same lexeme in different morphological forms: singular construct and suffixed (S141557, 9x: eng 'name/name of', spa 'nombre/su nombre', hin नाम, arb اسْمُهُ/بِاِسْم, kor 그의 이름은, swa 'jina lake/kwa jina'), plural and plural construct (S141560, 2x: eng 'their names/names of', spa 'sus nombres', hin नाम/उनके नाम, arb أَسْماءَهُم, kor 이름들, swa 'majina yao'), and prepositional-construct (S141561, 1x: eng 'according to name of', spa 'según el nombre de', hin के अनुसार नाम, arb كَاسْمِ, swa 'kwa jina la'). All are inflectional variants of a single semantic sense.
